entries.title: A subscription you connect lists its newest models without a restart
entries.body: When you connected a subscription such as Codex while Infinitary was open, models published after this version of Infinitary, such as GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, stayed missing until you quit and reopened the app. Infinitary now checks for them as soon as the sign-in finishes.
entries.noPicture: The model lists look the same; the newest models now appear in them right after a sign-in instead of after a restart.
